item.title: Cafe Spaghetti
item.description: Cafe Spaghetti is Chef Sal Lamboglia’s ode to the neighborhood Italian restaurant. Along with Cafe Spaghetti, the chef also has Swoony, Sal Tang, and Bar Ferdinando nearby. Aside from great neighborhood reviews, it also has a lush backyard garden. We made a reservation for 2 just 30 minutes before arriving at 6 PM. We were initially seated inside of the restaurant, but we decided to ask to be seated in the backyard.

item.title: Soboku
item.description: We just moved to the Brooklyn area, and our first official dinner together was at this neighborhood joint, Soboku. I thought we needed something light and savory, so Japanese cuisine is what came to mind. The restaurant has a pretty small kitchen, and it is the epitome of a quaint joint. The menu is a mix of a variety of Japanese foods ranging from rice bowls to curry and meat plates. We were able to walk in easily without any issues at around 7:00 PM on a Sunday evening.

item.title: Sunken Hundred
item.description:
